Priya Nair: Heads-up: starting a minimal SI sandbox integration track next month. scope: 4 SI teams, cloud listing readiness, and a hardware validation lab. aim to validate terraform quickstarts + a proctored troubleshooting capstone.
Julian Park: good call. recommend we require a minimal smoke-test bundle (deploy -> healthcheck -> sample inference) as the infra exercise. I'll prep the smoke-checker and a short runbook.
Marco Silva: hardware lab windows: vendor has availability 2024-11-11..2024-11-18. need to sync SI preferred times. also suggest a mentor shadow day before capstone.
Priya Nair: action items: Julian = smoke-checker + runbook, Marco = confirm vendor windows + access template, I'll draft a 2-page SI playbook (process + pass criteria). target: publish playbook and signups by 2024-10-25.
ops-bot: calendar event created: "SI Sandbox Integration - kickoff" 2024-10-28 10:00 PT. attendees: Priya Nair, Julian Park, Marco Silva. link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/si-sandbox-kickoff
Julian Park: will also add an infra lab checklist for logging and redaction. suggest recordings be optional with explicit consent.
Marco Silva: noted. i'll collect SI roster CSV and preferred windows.
Priya Nair: thanks team — will post draft playbook here when ready. :white_check_mark:
